subject: Assurance add-ons pricing and discount options — OliveHealth procurement
messages:
From: Samuel Price <sam.price@olivehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tanya Li <tanya.li@olivehealth.com>, procurement@olivehealth.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing breakdown needed for 'assurance' add-ons

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a line-by-line cost for the security/compliance items we discussed so we can slot them into our FY28 budget. Specifically we need:

- Audit log retention: monthly cost for 90 / 365 / 1095 day retention (per TB)
- Key management: KMS integration cost vs managed HSM seats (annual and monthly)
- Data residency: regional residency option for EU-only data (one-off migration + ongoing uplift)
- HIPAA add-on: what exactly is included and any excluded professional services

If you can also call out one-time implementation fees and any volume discounts (or credits) you have for 12/24 month contracts, that would be ideal. PDF line items preferred.

We'd like to circulate the numbers to legal and infra by EOD Tuesday PT.

Best,
Sam
Samuel Price
Head of IT Procurement — OliveHealth
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Price <sam.price@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown needed for 'assurance' add-ons

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching a starter quote that breaks the items down (see Redwood_Assurance_Pricing_Quote_20270504.pdf in attachments). Key highlights here in case procurement needs a quick summary: 

- Audit logs (per TB/month): 90d = $12/TB, 365d = $18/TB, 1095d = $26/TB. Day-based retention priced as a multiplier of base TB rate.
- KMS vs HSM: KMS integration included for free on Dedicated and Hosted plans; Managed HSM seats are $3,500/seat/month or $35,000/seat/year (includes HSM SLA and quarterly key escrow reports).
- Residency uplift: EU-only residency add-on is a 20% uplift on token/hosting costs plus a one-time migration/service fee (recommended estimate $18k for a medium footprint migration).
- HIPAA add-on: $8k/month platform assurance (BAA, audit artifact retention, config lock), plus optional professional services (SOW) for onboarding and validation.

Discount guidance:
- 12-month committed usage: 8% off listed add-on fees
- 24-month committed usage: 12% off listed add-on fees
- For deals > $250k ARR in total Redwood spend we can consider an additional one-time onboarding credit (applied as invoice credit) up to $25k.

I've looped in Ben and Laura to help with commercial packaging and to confirm any flexibility on credits. If legal needs any specific contract language, we can route to Rohan.

I will follow up with an itemized spreadsheet this afternoon if that helps.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(hannah.schmitt@redwood.com)

Attachment: Redwood_Assurance_Pricing_Quote_20270504.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Samuel Price <sam.price@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown needed for 'assurance' add-ons

Sam / Hannah —

Quick commercial note from my side: OliveHealth's projected usage that Hannah shared in the demo (roughly 12 TB/month ingestion, burst to 20 TB) puts you in a good spot for a modest commit. Two pragmatic options we typically propose: 

1) 12-month commitment (12% uplift on core token spend) + 8% off add-ons (as Hannah listed). Onboarding credit: $10k credit back over the first two invoices.
2) 24-month commit (18% uplift on core token spend) + 12% off add-ons and a $25k onboarding credit (one-time).

To accelerate approvals we can: 
- Translate the onboarding credit into a waiver for the one-time migration fee (so you effectively pay $0 migration, we invoice the add-ons thereafter).
- Offer a quarterly reconciliation so you only pay for actual TBs retained; this helps procurement avoid overcommitting to retention tiers.

Also flagging to legal: if you need HSM seat-level SLAs written into the order form, cc Rohan and we'll draft the clause.

Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Samuel Price <sam.price@olivehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tanya Li <tanya.li@olivehealth.com>, procurement@olivehealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown needed for 'assurance' add-ons

Thanks — helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement and infra: 

- Can you itemize the onboarding credit logic (applied how, timing)? We prefer credits applied against invoices rather than discounts on line items.
- For HSM seats: what is the minimum purchase term? We may want to buy fewer seats during pilot and scale later.
- Residency uplift: can you break the 20% uplift into a per-region flat fee instead? Our CFO prefers fixed monthly line items rather than percentage uplifts.

Also, legal asked for a short SOW for the migration estimate to justify the one-time fee. If you can drop a draft SOW we can attach to our procurement packet.

Sam

Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown needed for 'assurance' add-ons

Sam —

For the legal & SOW asks: we can provide a short SOW (attached: SOW_Assurance_Addons_v1.docx) that lays out: scope, migration tasks, acceptance criteria, deliverables and a fixed-fee estimate ($18k) with a change-order pathway. If OliveHealth prefers credits instead of invoiced migration fees, we can convert that $18k into a one-time invoice credit on sign (standard practice).

HSM seat term: minimum 3 months for pilots, month-to-month thereafter with 30-day notice for scale-down. Seat pricing pro-rated for partial months. We'll include the exact SLA language in the order form (99.95% availability and quarterly key attestations).

Residency uplift: happy to convert the 20% uplift into a flat regional fee. For OliveHealth's anticipated footprint (EU-only data subset) we estimate a flat fee of $9,500/month instead of a percentage; that will be fixed for the term.

I'll circulate updated language by EOD and can sync with your procurement counsel if they want to redline.

— Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Price <sam.price@olivehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown needed for 'assurance' add-ons

Sam —

Great — thanks for the quick feedback. To summarize the agreed commercial path so procurement can approve: 

- We will convert the $18k migration fee into a one-time onboarding credit applied against the first invoice on sign.
- Residency uplift converted to a fixed $9,500/month line item for EU-only residency.
- HSM seats available with 3-month minimum pilot term; pricing unchanged ($3,500/month seat) and pro-rated for partial months.
- Add-on discounts: 12-month commit = 8% off add-ons; 24-month commit = 12% off add-ons. For OliveHealth we will honor the 24-month add-on discount (12%) if you sign before May 20, 2027.

We have attached the updated quote and a draft SOW for procurement to include in the packet. If that looks good, please reply to confirm and I will route the order form + BAA to legal for signatures.

Looking forward to partnering —
Hannah
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
